title: Planner: Tab support for shared and private channels in Microsoft Teams in GCC, GCC-H and DoD
description: Now you can add Microsoft Planner as a tab in shared and private channels in Microsoft Teams, which allows to create and manage tasks directly within the channel.
descriptionHtml: Now you can add Microsoft Planner as a tab in shared and private channels in Microsoft Teams, which allows to create and manage tasks directly within the channel.
